column1: # B1143 item 4 (+ item 3 record-1 recon): WARRIOR (class 1) on TrollF000.
# Intimidation -> Fear (229, record 101): the Ti client's command table
# /taunt -- the only chat ability route is `/doability 1 - 10` (eqstr_us.txt
# branch: no target -> eqstr 0x306e ("You must have a target to
# InstillDoubt) requires an NPC target in combat range and casts spell 229
# (Fear) unresistably on a successful roll; Handle_OP_InstillDoubt (client
# _packet.cpp:9095) starts the reuse timer on every OP_InstillDoubt it
# receives, so ONE failed attempt would burn the cooldown.
# The success roll is made certain IN-WORLD with `#set skill 71 5000`
# MaxSkill) AFTER `#level 60` -- the skill rows for the switched class are
# created at LOGIN, so the pre-SQL (p3_combat1_skill.sql) alone is a NO-OP
# (char 67 had 0 character_skills rows before the leg). The in-world set is
# the reliable one; the pre-SQL is kept as a harmless belt-and-braces.
# This leg: (a) sweeps /doability 1..10 with the stunned TrollF000 targeted
# (the pcap shows which index, if any, sends 0x389e), then (b) opens the
# Combat Abilities window (alt+c, per the .fix leg's in-world still) for a
# still so the Intimidation button's pixel can be read for the follow-up
# click leg (p3_combat1b). Crippling Strike / Thunderkick (record 1) have NO
# ability strings in eqstr_us.txt (only the "Crippling Blow" crit message,
# 1021) -- they are not manually activatable in the Ti client; the record-1
